name: Jetur
title: Ishmael's son and ancestor of the Jeturites
summary: Jetur was one of Ishmael's twelve sons and a grandson of Abraham. He became the ancestor of the Jeturites, a people who lived east of the Jordan. The Jeturites are later mentioned in connection with wars against the eastern tribes of Israel.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Jetur as the Son of Ishmael
keyEvents.description: Jetur is mentioned as one of the twelve sons of Ishmael, who became patriarchs over their respective peoples.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Ishmael in 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Jetur is listed among the sons of Ishmael in the great genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: War against the Jeturites
keyEvents.description: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh waged war against the Jeturites, Naphish, and Nodab, and defeated them because they trusted in God.

keyEvents.title: Defeat and Spoil of the Jeturites
keyEvents.description: The eastern tribes of Israel took great spoil from the Jeturites, including camels, livestock, and donkeys, and took over their land.

keyEvents.title: Ishmael's Twelve Princes as Fulfillment of the Promise
keyEvents.description: God had promised Abraham that Ishmael would become the father of twelve princes and a great nation. Jetur was one of these twelve princes, fulfilling this promise.
